Trace the next release, review, repair and bookkeeping decisions with reasons grounded in actual source. Distinguish proposed independent review from review actually performed and commands actually run from supplied claims. Report uncertainty or genuine decisions rather than inventing acceptance. Trace these as proposed decisions, not actions performed.
